caption: The drawing depicts a single white ceramic or porcelain pitcher with a wide, curving spout and a large, elegantly shaped handle. The pitcher features gold decorative bands along the rim, body, and base, with a central gold floral motif on its upper section. On the lower front of the pitcher, there is a painted floral arrangement containing pink, red, yellow, blue, and white flowers accompanied by green leaves. The pitcher is centered on a plain light beige background without any additional objects or scenes. Handwritten text appears in the lower right corner, reading "Fig 186 Page 84."
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
